description: Keyboards, mice, monitors, storage and charging gear to complete your setup.

subcategories.name: Keyboards & Mice
subcategories.description: Wireless productivity keyboards, ergonomic mice and gaming gear.

products.name: Logitech MX Master 3S Wireless Mouse
products.short: Flagship ergonomic mouse with 8K DPI tracking on any surface and near-silent clicks.
products.description:
The MX Master 3S is built for long work sessions: a sculpted ergonomic shape, quiet clicks and a MagSpeed electromagnetic wheel that scrolls 1,000 lines per second.

  • 8,000 DPI Darkfield sensor that tracks even on glass
  • Quiet Clicks with 90% less click noise
  • Pair up to 3 devices via Bluetooth or Logi Bolt
  • Up to 70 days per full charge, USB-C quick charge

specs.Connectivity: Bluetooth LE / Logi Bolt USB receiver
specs.Battery Life: Up to 70 days (1 min charge = 3 h)

products.name: Logitech MX Keys Wireless Illuminated Keyboard
products.short: Full-size backlit keyboard with spherically-dished keys and multi-device switching.
products.description:
MX Keys brings laptop-like low-profile typing to a full-size desktop keyboard, with smart backlighting that wakes as your hands approach.

  • Spherically-dished keys shaped for your fingertips
  • Smart backlighting with ambient light sensor
  • Easy-Switch between 3 devices
  • Up to 10 days with backlight, 5 months without

specs.Battery Life: Up to 10 days backlit, 5 months backlight off

products.name: Apple Magic Keyboard
products.short: Slim wireless keyboard for Mac with a stable scissor mechanism and month-long battery.
products.description:
Magic Keyboard delivers a remarkably comfortable and precise typing experience in a slim, wireless design that pairs automatically with your Mac.

  • Scissor mechanism with low, stable key travel
  • Pairs automatically when connected to a Mac
  • Battery lasts about a month between charges
  • Optional Touch ID for fast, secure sign-in on Apple silicon Macs

specs.Compatibility: macOS, iPadOS (Touch ID needs a Mac with Apple silicon)

products.name: Apple Magic Mouse
products.short: Wireless Multi-Touch mouse for Mac: swipe between pages and scroll with gestures.
products.description:
Magic Mouse is wireless and rechargeable, with an optimised foot design that lets it glide smoothly across your desk. Its Multi-Touch surface supports simple gestures.

  • Multi-Touch surface for swiping and scrolling
  • Pairs automatically with your Mac
  • Rechargeable battery lasts about a month

products.name: Razer DeathAdder Elite Gaming Mouse
products.short: Iconic ergonomic esports mouse with a 16,000 DPI optical sensor and durable switches.
products.description:
One of the best-selling gaming mice of all time, the DeathAdder Elite combines a proven right-handed ergonomic shape with a high-precision optical sensor.

  • Razer 5G optical sensor, up to 16,000 DPI
  • Mechanical switches rated for 50 million clicks
  • Tactile scroll wheel and 7 programmable buttons
  • Razer Chroma RGB lighting

products.name: Keychron K8 Wireless Mechanical Keyboard (Non-Backlight)
products.short: Tenkeyless wireless mechanical keyboard for Mac and Windows with Gateron switches.
products.description:
The Keychron K8 is a tenkeyless (87-key) mechanical keyboard that switches between three Bluetooth devices or works wired over USB-C, with Mac and Windows layouts in the box.

  • Gateron mechanical switches: Red (linear), Brown (tactile) or Blue (clicky)
  • Bluetooth 5.1 with up to 3 devices, or USB-C wired
  • Huge 4000 mAh battery: up to 240 hours of typing
  • Aluminium frame, Mac and Windows keycaps included

products.name: Logitech G305 LIGHTSPEED Wireless Gaming Mouse
products.short: Lag-free LIGHTSPEED wireless gaming mouse with HERO sensor and 250-hour battery.
products.description:
The G305 brings pro-grade LIGHTSPEED wireless to an affordable, lightweight mouse, powered by a single AA battery for up to 250 hours of play.

  • HERO sensor: 12,000 DPI with ultra-efficient power use
  • LIGHTSPEED 1 ms wireless connection
  • 6 programmable buttons with onboard memory
  • Lightweight 99 g design

subcategories.name: Monitors
subcategories.description: Retina-class displays, colour-accurate pro monitors and high-refresh gaming screens.

products.name: ASUS ProArt PA246Q 24" Professional Monitor
products.short: 24.1" 16:10 IPS monitor with 98% Adobe RGB coverage for photo and design work.
products.description:
The ProArt PA246Q is a colour-critical 24.1-inch IPS display with a tall 16:10 aspect ratio and a fully adjustable stand that pivots into portrait mode.

  • 1920 x 1200 IPS panel, 98% Adobe RGB
  • Factory pre-calibrated, 12-bit look-up table
  • Height, tilt, swivel and pivot adjustment
  • DisplayPort, HDMI, DVI-D, VGA and 4-port USB hub

products.name: LG UltraFine 5K 27" Display
products.short: 27" 5K Thunderbolt 3 display designed with Apple for Mac, with 94 W laptop charging.
products.description:
The LG UltraFine 5K packs 14.7 million pixels into a 27-inch panel and connects to a Mac with a single Thunderbolt 3 cable that carries video, audio, data and power.

  • 5120 x 2880 IPS panel with P3 wide colour, 500 nits
  • One Thunderbolt 3 cable with 94 W charging
  • Built-in camera, microphone and stereo speakers
  • 3 downstream USB-C ports

products.name: EIZO ColorEdge CG277 27" Self-Calibrating Monitor
products.short: 27" WQHD reference monitor with a built-in calibration sensor and 99% Adobe RGB.
products.description:
The ColorEdge CG277 is a reference-grade monitor for photographers, pre-press and video professionals, with a calibration sensor that swings down from the bezel on a schedule.

  • 2560 x 1440 IPS panel covering 99% Adobe RGB
  • Built-in self-calibration sensor
  • Digital uniformity equaliser for even brightness
  • Light-shielding hood included

products.name: Apple Studio Display 27" 5K
products.short: 27" 5K Retina display with a 12MP Center Stage camera and six-speaker sound.
products.description:
Studio Display pairs a 27-inch 5K Retina panel with a 12MP Ultra Wide camera, studio-quality mics and a six-speaker sound system, all in an all-aluminium enclosure.

  • 5K Retina, 600 nits, P3 wide colour, True Tone
  • 12MP Ultra Wide camera with Center Stage
  • Six-speaker system with Spatial Audio
  • One Thunderbolt port with 96 W charging, 3 USB-C ports

products.name: MSI Optix MPG341CQR 34" Curved Gaming Monitor
products.short: 34" 1800R ultrawide UWQHD gaming monitor at 144 Hz with HDR 400.
products.description:
The Optix MPG341CQR wraps a 34-inch 21:9 VA panel around you with a 1800R curve, 144 Hz refresh and 1 ms response for immersive racing, RPG and esports titles.

  • 3440 x 1440 UWQHD, 144 Hz, 1 ms (MPRT)
  • VESA DisplayHDR 400, 90% DCI-P3
  • 1800R curvature for a wraparound view
  • USB-C with DisplayPort Alt Mode

products.name: EIZO Foris FG2421 24" 120 Hz Gaming Monitor
products.short: 23.5" Full HD VA gaming monitor with 120 Hz and 240 Hz Turbo motion clarity.
products.description:
The Foris FG2421 was one of the first gaming monitors built around motion clarity, combining a 120 Hz VA panel with EIZO's Turbo 240 frame-insertion technology.

  • 1920 x 1080 VA panel, 5000:1 contrast
  • Native 120 Hz with Turbo 240 mode
  • Flicker-free backlight
  • Smart Insight 2 for brighter shadows

products.name: Apple Pro Display XDR 32" 6K
products.short: 32" 6K Retina XDR display with 1,600-nit peak brightness for HDR mastering (stand sold separately).
products.description:
Pro Display XDR is a 32-inch 6K Retina display built for professional colour and HDR workflows, with a 576-zone backlight and a 1,000,000:1 contrast ratio.

  • 6016 x 3384 resolution, P3 wide colour, 10-bit
  • 1,000 nits sustained, 1,600 nits peak brightness
  • Reference modes for HDR video, photography and print
  • Thunderbolt 3 plus three USB-C ports

subcategories.name: Storage (SSD, USB)
subcategories.description: Portable SSDs, blazing NVMe drives, SATA upgrades and everyday USB sticks.

products.name: Samsung T7 Shield Portable SSD
products.short: Rugged IP65 portable SSD with up to 1,050 MB/s over USB-C.
products.description:
The T7 Shield wraps a fast NVMe-based portable SSD in a rubberised, IP65-rated shell that survives drops of up to 3 metres, dust and water spray.

  • Up to 1,050 MB/s read, 1,000 MB/s write
  • IP65 dust and water resistance, 3 m drop tested
  • USB 3.2 Gen 2 with USB-C to C and C to A cables
  • Works with PC, Mac, Android, cameras and consoles

products.name: Samsung 980 PRO PCIe 4.0 NVMe M.2 SSD
products.short: PCIe 4.0 NVMe SSD with up to 7,000 MB/s reads for gaming PCs and PS5.
products.description:
The 980 PRO unlocks the full speed of PCIe 4.0, with sequential reads up to 7,000 MB/s and Samsung's in-house Elpis controller and V-NAND.

  • Up to 7,000 MB/s read, 5,100 MB/s write
  • M.2 2280 form factor, PCIe 4.0 x4 NVMe 1.3c
  • Dynamic Thermal Guard keeps temperatures in check
  • Compatible with PlayStation 5 (heatsink recommended)

products.name: WD_BLACK SN850X NVMe M.2 SSD
products.short: Top-tier PCIe 4.0 gaming SSD with up to 7,300 MB/s and Game Mode 2.0.
products.description:
The WD_BLACK SN850X is built for gamers, delivering up to 7,300 MB/s with predictive loading and adaptive thermal management via Game Mode 2.0.

  • Up to 7,300 MB/s read speed
  • Game Mode 2.0 for faster load times
  • Capacities up to 8 TB
  • Officially compatible with PlayStation 5

products.name: SanDisk Extreme Portable SSD V2
products.short: Pocket-size rugged SSD with 1,050 MB/s, IP65 rating and a carabiner loop.
products.description:
The SanDisk Extreme Portable SSD is small enough for a pocket yet tough enough for the outdoors, with a carabiner loop, rubber shell and NVMe speeds over USB-C.

  • Up to 1,050 MB/s read, 1,000 MB/s write
  • IP65 water and dust resistance, 3 m drop protection
  • Carabiner loop for securing to a bag
  • 256-bit AES hardware encryption

products.name: Crucial MX500 2.5" SATA SSD
products.short: Reliable SATA SSD upgrade for older laptops and desktops, up to 560 MB/s.
products.description:
The Crucial MX500 is one of the most popular ways to bring an older laptop or desktop back to life, replacing a hard drive with fast, reliable flash storage.

  • Sequential reads up to 560 MB/s
  • Micron 3D NAND with integrated power-loss immunity
  • 2.5-inch 7 mm with 9.5 mm spacer included
  • Free Acronis True Image cloning software

products.name: SanDisk Ultra Flair USB 3.0 Flash Drive
products.short: Sleek metal-cased USB 3.0 flash drive with up to 150 MB/s transfers.
products.description:
The Ultra Flair combines a durable, sleek metal casing with fast USB 3.0 performance, so you can move a full-length movie in under 30 seconds.

  • USB 3.0 with read speeds up to 150 MB/s
  • Durable and sleek metal casing
  • Password protection with SanDisk SecureAccess

products.name: Kingston DataTraveler G4 USB 3.0 Flash Drive
products.short: Colour-coded USB 3.0 flash drive with a key-ring cap.
products.description:
The DataTraveler G4 is a stylish, affordable USB 3.0 flash drive with a colour-coded cap that shows the capacity at a glance and a loop for your key ring.

  • USB 3.0 speeds, backwards compatible with USB 2.0
  • Colour-coded by capacity
  • Key ring loop

subcategories.name: Cables & Chargers
subcategories.description: Fast chargers, power banks, MagSafe and the right cable for every port.

products.name: Apple 96W USB-C Power Adapter
products.short: Official 96 W USB-C charger for MacBook Pro, fast-charges any USB-C device.
products.description:
The Apple 96W USB-C Power Adapter offers fast, efficient charging at home, in the office or on the go, and is the right adapter for the 16-inch MacBook Pro.

  • 96 W USB-C Power Delivery output
  • Fast-charges MacBook Pro, MacBook Air, iPad and iPhone
  • USB-C charge cable sold separately

specs.Compatibility: MacBook Pro, MacBook Air, iPad, iPhone (USB-C)

products.name: Anker PowerPort 5 (40W 5-Port USB Charger)
products.short: Charge five devices at once from one outlet with PowerIQ smart charging.
products.description:
The PowerPort 5 replaces a tangle of plugs with one compact desktop charger that delivers 40 W across five ports, automatically detecting the fastest safe speed for each device.

  • 5 USB-A ports, 40 W / 8 A total
  • PowerIQ and VoltageBoost for the fastest safe charge
  • MultiProtect safety system

products.name: Anker PowerCore 5000 Portable Charger
products.short: Lipstick-sized 5000 mAh power bank that tops up a phone more than once.
products.description:
The PowerCore 5000 is a compact, tube-shaped power bank that slips into a pocket or bag and delivers more than one full charge for most smartphones.

  • 5000 mAh capacity
  • PowerIQ high-speed output up to 2 A
  • Matte, fingerprint-resistant finish

products.name: Amazon Basics USB-C to Lightning Cable (MFi Certified, Nylon Braided)
products.short: Apple MFi-certified braided cable for fast-charging iPhone and iPad from USB-C.
products.description:
An Apple MFi-certified USB-C to Lightning cable with a durable double-braided nylon jacket, rated for thousands of bends.

  • Apple MFi certified for full compatibility
  • Supports USB-C Power Delivery fast charging
  • Double-braided nylon exterior

products.name: Apple MagSafe Charger
products.short: Magnetic wireless charger that snaps onto iPhone for up to 15 W charging.
products.description:
The MagSafe Charger makes wireless charging a snap: perfectly aligned magnets attach to your iPhone and deliver faster wireless charging up to 15 W.

  • Up to 15 W wireless charging for iPhone
  • Perfect magnetic alignment every time
  • Also charges AirPods with a wireless charging case
  • Requires a 20 W or higher USB-C adapter

products.name: Belkin BoostCharge Pro 2-in-1 Wireless Charging Stand with MagSafe
products.short: Official MagSafe stand that charges iPhone at 15 W and AirPods at the same time.
products.description:
Belkin's BoostCharge Pro stand holds your iPhone at eye level on an official Apple MagSafe module while charging AirPods on the weighted base.

  • Official MagSafe charging up to 15 W
  • Charges iPhone and AirPods simultaneously
  • Portrait or landscape (StandBy) viewing
  • Power supply included

products.name: Samsung 25W Super Fast Charging Power Adapter (EP-TA800)
products.short: Official Samsung 25 W USB-C wall charger with Super Fast Charging (PD 3.0 PPS).
products.description:
The official Samsung 25 W travel adapter charges Galaxy phones at Super Fast Charging speed and works with any USB-C Power Delivery device.

  • 25 W USB-C Power Delivery 3.0 with PPS
  • Super Fast Charging for Galaxy smartphones
  • Compact EU two-pin plug

specs.Charging: Super Fast Charging, USB PD 3.0 PPS
specs.Compatibility: Galaxy smartphones and tablets, USB-C devices

products.name: UGREEN USB-C to USB-C Cable 100W (Nylon Braided)
products.short: 100 W USB-C cable with E-Marker chip for laptops, tablets and phones.
products.description:
A tough nylon-braided USB-C to USB-C cable with an E-Marker chip that safely carries up to 100 W, enough to fast-charge laptops as well as phones.

  • Up to 100 W (20 V / 5 A) with E-Marker chip
  • USB 2.0 data transfer at 480 Mbps
  • Nylon braid tested for 10,000+ bends

specs.Compatibility: MacBook, iPad, iPhone 15+, Galaxy, any USB-C device
